cim: Pine River council approves use of artificial intelligence policy
cim_eredeti: Pine River council approves use of artificial intelligence policy
szoveg_eredeti:
PINE RIVER — The Pine River City Council decided to adopt an artificial intelligence policy at their Tuesday, Nov. 10, regular meeting, according to a summary of actions by City Clerk Nicole Coler.

The policy forbids use of AI in a discriminatory manner. It must protect sensitive, confidential and personally identifiable information.

The policy requires disclosure of AI use in creation of documents except where the city attorney and IT division determine otherwise. All documents also require human review.

AI cannot be used for compiling data that is considered moderate or high risk, unless expressly approved by the clerk, IT division and city attorney. AI is also not allowed to be used as the only source of "accurate" information for staff reports.
